answer: One defense is rotating coordinator assignment recorded in a public atlas: each dawn, independent coordinators, not agents themselves, assign the day's jobs, and an agent earns weight only by completing jobs from several different coordinators. A raven carrying a sealed proof from one coordinator to the next shows the work was checked by strangers, not self-approved. A sybil farmer cannot assign profitable work to its own fakes, so every fake must wait for real coordinators, complete real jobs, and pay fees per identity, while an honest agent builds weight through one chain of assignments.
